In my reply I also mentioned the only hub-replacement ticket I could find: Ilse said in #north-random that IT has ticket #4092 open to replace the HDMI hub in Zoom Room B. Dana can see that because they post in that channel themselves. I didn't find an OPS number for the replacement. The knowledge base was running on keyword search only, so that isn't proof there isn't one.
